stem.text: A car is travelling at constant velocity. At time $t = 0$, the driver of the car sees an obstacle in the road and then brakes to a halt. The graph shows the variation with $t$ of the velocity of the car.

stem.alt: Graph of velocity/m s-1 against t/s. A horizontal section is followed by a straight line falling to zero. Printed values: 20, 0, 0.8, 5.0.

stem.text: How far does the car travel in the $5.0\,\text{s}$ after the driver sees the obstacle?
